title: Huge cell text ods 001
notes: real spreadsheet text stress: ONE cell holding the deterministic 48,000-char string 'lorem ipsum ' * 4000 in both office:string-value and its display text:p. ODF has NO ECMA-376-style 32,767-char cell cap, so 48k in one cell is spec-legal here (the xlsx counterpart must pin at 32767) — readers that truncate at OOX limits are the fidelity finding this fixture hunts. Reference text is the exact same string(s), byte-for-byte as inserted, no truncation allowed. The repetitive text would collapse hard under deflate, but the normalized container is STORED for cross-environment byte determinism (INV-4): saved blob is 100350 bytes, far under the 10 MB cap. The normative counter reads table:table=1. Overflow/wrap/print-area behavior over the giant strings is the fixture's point.
